finalText:
**Migration done in `packages/`.** 12 files, 36 calls moved to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

All `packages/` and `lib/` files pass `node --check`. Zero `db.query` left outside vendor.

Left alone on purpose:

| Thing | Why |
|---|---|
| `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` | Header says do not edit. Replaced on upgrade. |
| `cache.query` calls | Different API. Not part of this. |
| `db.query` in `[lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13)` | The deprecated method itself. |

Next: drop `db.query` from `lib/db.js` once vendor is off it.
